## Description and Rationale

I'm a PhD student at Georgia Tech's Aerospace Systems Design Laboratory (ASDL), working on aircraft trajectory optimization. Taxi-out time is a bit outside my usual arrival-side focus, but it's close enough to be genuinely interesting, and I couldn't resist a good excuse to dig into real ops data from major European airports. Looking forward to seeing what I can build!
